question: Which of the following best describes the distinguishing physical mark of the cheetah that helps differentiate it from a leopard?
answer: Long teardrop-shaped lines on each side of the nose from the corner of its eyes to its mouth
options: White patches distributed randomly across its entire body
Long teardrop-shaped lines on each side of the nose from the corner of its eyes to its mouth
Dark circular rosettes without any spots inside them
A shorter tail with distinct dark rings near the end
explanation: The chapter notes that the cheetah is often mistaken for a leopard, but its distinguishing marks are the long teardrop-shaped lines on each side of its nose from the corner of its eyes to its mouth.
question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा चीthe की उस विशिष्ट शारीरिक पहचान का सबसे अच्छा वर्णन करता है जो इसे तेंदुए से अलग करने में मदद करती है?
options_hi: पूरे शरीर में यादृच्छिक रूप से वितरित सफेद धब्बे
नाक के प्रत्येक तरफ आँखों के कोने से मुँह तक लंबी आँसू के आकार की रेखाएँ
बिना किसी आंतरिक धब्बे के गहरे गोलाकार रोसेट
अंत के पास विशिष्ट काले छल्लों वाली एक छोटी पूंछ
explanation_hi: अध्याय में उल्लेख किया गया है कि चीता को अक्सर तेंदुआ समझ लिया जाता है, लेकिन इसकी विशिष्ट पहचान इसकी नाक के दोनों किनारों पर आँखों के कोने से मुँह तक जाने वाली लंबी आँसू के आकार की रेखाएँ हैं।

question: What was the primary reason for the near-extinction of the Asian cheetah, as discussed in the text?
answer: Decline of available habitat and prey
options: Extreme climatic changes and prolonged droughts
Severe epidemic diseases affecting feline species
Decline of available habitat and prey
Natural competition with leopards and tigers
explanation: According to the chapter, today the Asian cheetah is nearly extinct specifically due to a decline of available habitat and prey.

question: In which year was the cheetah officially declared extinct in India?
explanation: The text explicitly states that the cheetah species was declared extinct in India long back in 1952.
question_hi: भारत में चीता को आधिकारिक तौर पर किस वर्ष विलुप्त घोषित किया गया था?
explanation_hi: पाठ स्पष्ट रूप से बताता है कि भारत में चीता प्रजाति को बहुत पहले 1952 में विलुप्त घोषित कर दिया गया था।

question: What is the recorded top speed of the cheetah as mentioned in the chapter?
explanation: The chapter identifies the cheetah as the world's fastest land mammal, capable of moving at a speed of 112 km./hr.
question_hi: अध्याय में उल्लिखित चीते की दर्ज की गई अधिकतम गति क्या है?
explanation_hi: अध्याय चीते को दुनिया के सबसे तेज गति वाले थनधारी जीव के रूप में पहचानता है, जो 112 किमी./घंटा की गति से चल सकता है।

question:
Consider the following statements:
1. The cheetah is a unique and specialised member of the cat family.
2. Prior to the 20th century, cheetahs were widely distributed throughout Africa and Australia.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
explanation: Statement 1 is correct as the text states the cheetah is a unique and specialised member of the cat family. Statement 2 is incorrect because prior to the 20th century, cheetahs were widely distributed throughout Africa and Asia, not Australia.
